claims.claim_text: Cosmetic marketing claiming treatment of psoriasis
claims.explanation: Cosmetic marketing cannot claim treatment of psoriasis.

tone.excerpt: Lumo announces clinical evaluation confirming formula cures psoriasis without steroids.
tone.explanation: The copy makes unauthorized medical/disease cure claims, which violates brand voice governance and safety standards.

notes.note: Remove disease treatment claims immediately to comply with regulatory and brand rules.
